mechanism: Sertraline increases serotonergic neurotransmission while phenelzine inhibits monoamine oxidase, creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome through combined serotonergic excess.
action: Absolute contraindication: do not co-administer; maintain minimum 14-day washout after phenelzine before starting sertraline, or 5-7 days after sertraline before starting phenelzine.
